lines.text: Here we observe the baker... in her natural habitat. Rising... before the bread itself.
But the orders... arrive at night. By text. By DM. An endless flock of "can I get a dozen?"
And yet... the pre-order bot takes each one, prints the ticket, and sends the pickup reminder. Remarkable.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Pre-orders, sorted while you sleep. DM us the word PLAN. You're still the captain.
